results.title: Anti Aging Medicine Congress: What’s Actually New This Year Versus Recycled Content
results.description: A practitioner attending her third anti-aging medicine congress in as many years notices something frustrating: several sessions cover essentially the same ground she sat through twelve months earlier, updated slides, familiar speakers, but no genuinely new research behind the core content. This happens more often than conference marketing admits... Read the full article on TechBullion.
